meta.title: Kori — Where Capital Meets Purpose
meta.description: Diaspora investment infrastructure connecting investors with vetted African entrepreneurs through a transparent demonstration experience.

hero.title: Where <highlight>capital</highlight> meets purpose
hero.description: A blockchain-powered co-investment platform connecting diaspora investors with vetted African entrepreneurs — visible, traceable, built to last.

fundingGap.label: Funding Gap
fundingGap.description: Africa's unmet startup capital needs in 2024 — structural, not cyclical.

vcDecline.description: African venture funding dropped 53% from 2022 to 2024 — not because the founders disappeared, but because the capital did.

remittances.label: Diaspora Remittances
remittances.description: Annual diaspora flows into Africa — patient, aligned capital with no structured investment vehicle.

startupFounder.title: Startup Founder

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: A broken capital stack on both sides of the corridor
problem.description: African entrepreneurs face bank loans at 30-50% interest, inaccessible public funding, and no infrastructure to reach international private capital. Meanwhile, diaspora investors — educated in the West, connected to the continent — hold a structural insight advantage that no amount of due diligence can replicate. No platform bridges them.

01.title: Debt is irrational
01.description: African bank loans carry 30-50% interest rates. For early-stage ventures, debt financing is economically impossible — not inadvisable, but mathematically ruinous.

02.title: Public capital is a dead end
02.description: Bureaucratic processes so burdensome that most founders never apply, rationally self-selecting out of a system with no guarantee of success.

03.title: International capital requires a network no one has
03.description: Accessing Western private capital requires investor relationships that most African entrepreneurs simply don't have — and no infrastructure bridges that gap.

04.title: Diaspora capital has nowhere to go
04.description: Professionals with deep market knowledge and deployment-ready capital are locked out of a structured, trusted vehicle to invest in the continent they understand.

solution.label: The Solution
solution.title: Capital becomes <highlight>architecture</highlight> — visible, traceable, built to last
solution.quote: “The platform that connects diaspora investors with African entrepreneurs — structured, on-chain, and built for both sides of the corridor.”
solution.description: Kori enables diaspora investors to pool capital and co-invest in African startups through a blockchain-powered infrastructure built on smart contracts and stablecoins. Every transaction is secure, transparent, and efficient — eliminating the friction, opacity, and currency risk that have made cross-border impact investing inaccessible.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Every project, every dollar, every milestone — visible. The blockchain isn't the product; visibility is.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Capital that builds real things. Not speculation. Not extraction. Construction — with patient, aligned investors who understand the markets they back.

access.title: Access
access.description: Investment infrastructure rebuilt for those who have been excluded. Diaspora investors as the lead class, not an afterthought.

rails.title: Stablecoin Rails
rails.description: Stablecoin-native settlement removes correspondent banking friction, international wire costs, and local currency conversion — structurally, not incrementally.

process.label: How It Works
process.title: A co-investment model built for the <highlight>corridor</highlight>
process.description: A lead investor curates and backstops each deal. Diaspora investors participate on identical economic terms. Smart contracts enforce the structure. Stablecoins settle the capital — instantly, transparently, without intermediaries.

vetted.title: Vetted Deal Flow
vetted.description: African startups apply through Kori's structured vetting process. A lead investor underwrites the deal — curating only the opportunities that meet the threshold.

syndicate.title: Syndicate Co-investment
syndicate.description: Diaspora investors browse, commit, and co-invest alongside the lead at identical economic terms. Multi-signatory wallets structure the capital pool on-chain.

settlement.title: Stablecoin Settlement
settlement.description: Capital flows via stablecoin rails — removing currency risk, wire delays, and correspondent banking costs. Every transaction is traceable in real time.

whyNow.quote: “The best African startup deals of the next decade are being missed right now — not because the founders aren't there, but because <highlight>the investors aren't connected to them.</highlight>”

cycle.title: Cycle Low = Entry Point
cycle.description: Africa's VC market reached its 2024 trough — one year after global peers began recovering. Valuations are compressed, quality founders are available, and the next wave of capital is forming. Kori enters at the bottom.

infrastructure.title: On-Chain Infrastructure Maturing
infrastructure.description: AngelList's launch of stablecoin-funded SPVs and broader on-chain infrastructure confirm that the settlement layer is converging toward stablecoins — validating Kori's money-system design.

asymmetry.title: Information Asymmetry is Kori's Moat
asymmetry.description: Western VC concentrates on AI and software. Africa needs capital most in energy, infrastructure, healthcare, agritech, and edtech. Diaspora investors are structurally positioned to close this gap.

validation.title: The Market Has Already Validated the Need
validation.description: Earlier diaspora syndicate models proved the demand but struggled with infrastructure. Kori is purpose-built around the visibility and operating structure those models lacked.

investors.title: Deploy capital in markets you understand
investors.description: You have the network. You have the insight. You have the capital. What you've never had is a structured, trusted, on-chain vehicle built specifically for you.

items.three: Full visibility on capital flows and milestone tracking
items.four: Stablecoin settlement — no wire risk, no FX conversion

founders.description: You don't need to explain your market to a team in Silicon Valley. Kori connects you with investors who've seen your market from the inside — and back it with conviction.

items.two: Structured financing without 30-50% bank lending rates
items.three: Receive capital in stablecoins — eliminating currency conversion friction
items.five: Pre-seed to Series A focus across Ethiopia, Kenya, Ghana, and South Africa
